messages.subject: For Emma Delaney | Energy, chemicals and government stakeholder strategy
messages.body:
Dear OMV Investor Relations Team,

Please place this executive introduction before Ms. Emma Delaney, Chief Executive Officer.

OMV's energy and chemicals transformation operates at the intersection of governments, regulators, sustainability commitments and major industrial partnerships. That environment aligns closely with my current mandate.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My responsibilities span government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory. I also support stakeholder governance around a major industrial renewable-energy platform and coordinated a carbon-accounting evidence pilot using operating data.

I would welcome a senior discussion about where this combination of government relations, sustainability and industrial stakeholder strategy might support OMV's priorities. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to OMV.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
